item.title: New ordinance would hold contractors responsible for breached water lines
item.description: By Bonnie Culverhouse Minden City Council is considering an ordinance that will hold contracting companies responsible for digging mistakes. There is currently a lot of boring work going on in the city limits. item.title: Are church services suspended? Email us and we will publish closure lists this weekend
item.description: Is your church suspending services this Sunday, due to inclement weather? Please send us an email at wpjnewsla@gmail.com and we will post it later today and tomorrow. Please include the name and address of the church. Thank you and everyone stay safe!
